Create Terms New Layout

Objective: Redesign the Terms of Service page layout.

Redesign layout old from: https://villume.com/term-of-service

Notes: Long-form legal content. Improve readability: clear headings, section navigation/anchors, comfortable line length, table of contents.

Redesign concept (applies to all)

  • Redesign the OLD layout into the NEW Villume design language used on the redesigned marketing site.
  • Use the new design system: Geist / Geist Mono typography, design tokens, light & dark theme.
  • Clean, modern, photorealistic-gallery aesthetic consistent with Home/About/Templates/Contact.
  • Fully responsive (mobile / tablet / desktop).
  • Keep all existing content/fields; this is a visual/layout redesign, not a feature change.
  • Deliverable: UI design/layout (mockup) ready for slicing & integration.

Terms redesign — RESULT

The new Terms of Use layout has been redesigned in the new Villume design language (Geist / Geist Mono typography, design tokens, light & dark theme, fully responsive). All existing legal content is preserved — this is a visual/layout redesign.

Highlights

  • Sticky table of contents with scroll-spy anchor navigation
  • Numbered sections (01–08) with sub-clauses for comfortable scanning
  • Breadcrumb + effective-date meta, contact callout, and back-to-top
  • Consistent with the redesigned Home / About / Templates / Contact pages
